The Board of Directors of Asante Kotoko have appointed the club’s Director of Football, Stanley Menzo Purl, as head coach following a difficult start to the 2026/2027 Ghana Premier League season.
The decision comes after Kotoko went four consecutive league matches without a win. The Porcupine Warriors currently sit 11th in the league table, with 14 points from 11 matches.
Kotoko has been without a head coach since Eric Tinkler resigned after the club’s first four matches of the season. Hamza Obeng served as interim assistant coach following Tinkler’s departure.
In a statement issued on Thursday, November 19, the club said Menzo would take on the additional role of head coach of the senior team supported by Messrs Boakye Ansah. Mendes Diogo will serve as technical adviser, while Hamza Obeng will continue as head coach of the youth team.
The club stated that the changes are intended to help the team return to winning ways. The Board urged all supporters to refrain from misconduct after matches.
Menzo joined Kotoko as Director of Football in June 2026, bringing tactical and coaching experience. The Dutch tactician has managed several teams, including SC Cambuur, FC Volendam, Lierse SK, Ajax Cape Town and Beijing Guoan.
Kotoko will face Bechem United in their Matchday 11 fixture, aiming to restore the team’s former glory.
